rows.Origin:
Bred by Tim Hermann Kordes (Germany, 2003).
Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 2015 as 'Märchenzauber'.
Introduced in Australia by Treloar Roses in 2018 as 'Fairytale Magic'.
Introduced in United States by Star Roses & Plants (California) in 2019 as 'Bliss Parfuma'.
rows.Bloom: Cream - pink. Creamy pink, apricot center. Moderate fragrance. up to 120 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, compact. Matte, medium green, leathery foliage. 5 leaflets.

Height: up to 35" (up to 90cm). Width: up to 28" (up to 70cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 5b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
